entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr planeswalker from Theros who ascended to godhood as God of Revels and was killed by Elspeth in Nyx.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Xenagos's birthplane, home of the gods.

entities.name: Raissa
entities.description: Xenagos's mother, who raised him despite his attempts to kill her.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God aware of the threat Xenagos posed, who shot an arrowhead into him before his ascension.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God who enacted the Silence of the Gods.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The Sun god, offended by Xenagos's ascension, who called him the usurper.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker, Sun god's champion, who led armies at Akros and killed Xenagos.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Elspeth's friend who came with her to Nyx.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: A man killed during the Great Revel.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: Elspeth's spear, thrown into Xenagos's chest.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The realm of the gods, where Xenagos died.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Kruphix's act forcing the gods to remain in Nyx without contact with mortals.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A polis attacked by Xenagos's forces and besieged by minotaurs.

events.summary: Xenagos's spark ignited during the Bakkeia and he became a planeswalker.
events.quote: this lifestyle led to his ascension, his spark igniting during the Bakkeia.

events.summary: Xenagos returned to Theros and attacked Meletis, Akros and Setessa with otherworldly monsters, blinding the gods.
events.quote: These attacks became so severe that the gods themselves began to go blind, cut off from their oracles.

events.summary: Kruphix enacted the Silence of the Gods, keeping the gods in Nyx.
events.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

events.summary: After a Great Revel following the siege of Akros, Xenagos ascended to godhood as god of revels, and Elspeth was scapegoated for Daxos's death and exiled.
events.quote: Xenagos held the position of the god of the revels, furthering the chaos and distrust of the established pantheon.

events.summary: Elspeth and Ajani arrived in Nyx, and Xenagos knocked Elspeth down.
events.quote: Elspeth and her friend Ajani arrived in Nyx to set Theros right again.

events.summary: Elspeth threw Godsend into Xenagos's chest, detonating Nylea's arrowhead and killing him in Nyx.
events.quote: Elspeth managed to throw the spear into Xenagos's chest
